title: Jonathan's Batsuits Data Pack
description: This data pack is full of recipes for Jonathan's Batsuits. The recipes include items from other mods, and a modpack will be linked in the description.
body:
The recipes datapack will be moved over to this seperate project to help differentiate between the mod, the recipes modpack, and the recipes datapack.

[Jonathan's Batsuits Mod](https://modrinth.com/modpack/jonathans-batsuits)

[Jonathan's Batsuits Recipe Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/jonathans-batsuits-recipe-modpack)
